package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

type TeacherDialogClaim struct {
	ClaimToken  string
	WorkerID    string
	Now         time.Time
	LockedUntil time.Time
}

// TeacherDialogJob owns durable intake, fenced processing, pending delivery,
// and atomic decision/outbox persistence for one Dialog request.
type TeacherDialogJob interface {
	Accept(ctx context.Context, job domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error)
	Claim(ctx context.Context, claim TeacherDialogClaim) (domain.TeacherDialogJob, bool, error)
	RenewLease(ctx context.Context, eventID, claimToken string, now, lockedUntil time.Time) error
	SaveGenerated(
		ctx context.Context,
		eventID string,
		claimToken string,
		decision domain.TeacherDecision,
		event domain.IntegrationEvent,
		responseBody string,
		aiExecutionID string,
		now time.Time,
	) error
	SaveCoordinatedResponse(ctx context.Context, eventID, claimToken string, response domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse, now time.Time) error
	CompleteDelivery(ctx context.Context, eventID, claimToken, messageID string, now time.Time) error
	RecordFailedNoEffect(ctx context.Context, eventID, claimToken string, proof domain.TeacherDialogNoEffectProof, outcome domain.TeacherDialogRecoverableOutcome, failureCode string, now time.Time) error
	MarkReconciliation(ctx context.Context, eventID, claimToken string, state domain.TeacherTurnReconciliationState, errorCode string, now time.Time) error
	GetCursor(ctx context.Context, dialogID string) (domain.TeacherDialogTurnCursor, error)
	Retry(ctx context.Context, eventID, claimToken, errorCode string, retryAt, now time.Time) error
	Block(ctx context.Context, eventID, claimToken, errorCode string, now time.Time) error
}
